mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies and a temperature of 52 degrees out at the Military Ridge State Trail.

The City of Verona is busy reviewing new development proposals for the November 4th Plan Commission meeting, including plans for Ardent Glen and various site permits. Also, remember that property tax bills will be hitting mailboxes by December 15.

There is plenty to do in our community, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today, followed by a variety of trivia nights and live music performances throughout the week, including the Main Street Trick or Treat event this coming October 29.
In our weekly report, on October 15, officers from the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I after reports of dangerous driving, though no injuries were reported.
It is a great day to grab a scoop of our flavor of the day, Pumpkin Pecan, and you can head over when the store opens today at 10:00 AM.
